shoes-spreadsheet.title: Hacoo Shoes Spreadsheet: Links, Sizes & Photo Checks
shoes-spreadsheet.intro: Compare Hacoo shoe links by exact style, measurements and useful photos. Build a shortlist and recognise when a listing no longer matches.

sections.heading: Start with a shoe shortlist you can actually verify
paragraphs: A search for a Hacoo shoes spreadsheet usually starts with a photograph: a trainer, a particular colour or a shape you want to find again. A long list of links is only useful if it helps you identify that exact shoe. Begin with the type of shoe and its distinctive details, then record the destination, listing identifier, selected style, size information and date. A row without those fields is a lead to investigate, not a verified recommendation. More rows do not automatically mean better choices.

Hacoos.pro is an independent guide. Its product and category buttons lead to the separate product catalogue; they are not official Hacoo app listings and do not establish that a shoe is available in Hacoo. For an item found inside the app, use the original app link and the information attached to that order. Keeping those two routes separate prevents a familiar photograph from being mistaken for proof that two sellers, inventories or support policies are the same.

sections.heading: Match the exact style before comparing prices
paragraphs: Open the listing and compare the overall silhouette, sole, upper panels, fastening and colour placement with the photograph you saved. Then choose the intended style. A listing can put several designs under one title, so the first image and lowest displayed price may belong to another option. Watch whether the thumbnail, option name and price change together. Save the visible listing ID and the selected option; a marketing name by itself is a weak reference when sellers rename pages.

Make a simple row for each candidate: destination URL, listing ID, style or colour, size, displayed price, measurement source and last check. Leave unavailable information blank instead of filling it from a similar shoe. If two links share a photograph, do not combine them until their identifiers and options agree. A familiar picture can be reused. The purpose of the shortlist is to make differences visible before you spend money, not to make every candidate look complete.

sections.heading: Compare measurements using the same method
paragraphs: Start with your feet and a comfortable pair used for a similar purpose. Measure both feet while standing and wearing the socks you expect to use, following the measuring method shown by the listing. Record the longer foot. A seller may label a number as foot length, insole length or outsole length; those are different measurements. Do not compare them as if they were interchangeable. If the chart never defines the number, ask for clarification before choosing a size.

A removable insole from a comfortable shoe can provide an additional reference, but its length does not prove the usable space in another design. Heel shape, padding, arch position and toe-box width also affect fit. Compare the listing's method and shape with your reference rather than applying one universal allowance. EU, UK and US conversions are useful labels, not a guarantee. When the chart and label disagree, save both and resolve the discrepancy instead of simply ordering your usual number.

sections.heading: Read shoe photos as evidence with limits
paragraphs: Useful photos show the side profile, both shoes together, heels, soles, toe boxes and the size label. Compare left and right symmetry, visible glue, stitching and the alignment of panels. Distinguish a clear defect from an effect of angle, shadow or compression. One close-up without a view of the whole shoe can make a small mark look much larger. Ask for a wider view if the evidence is ambiguous, and check that all photos belong to the same style and size.

The term QC means quality checking here, not a promise that Hacoo supplies warehouse inspection photographs. A seller image, buyer review and photograph of your own delivered item serve different purposes. Listing photos describe an offer; recent buyer photos may reveal what someone received; your own photos document your order. None alone proves authenticity, long-term durability or comfort. Avoid labels such as best batch or guaranteed quality unless there is specific, credible evidence explaining exactly what was assessed.

sections.heading: Compare the total decision, not the cheapest number
paragraphs: The price on a catalogue card is a reference, and the selected option may cost more. Check the final item price, shipping, any taxes shown at checkout and the currency before paying on the destination service. Hacoos.pro displays USD references for easier comparison; it does not calculate a final delivered quote. A cheaper shoe with missing measurements can be a worse choice than a better documented option, particularly when the intended use requires a close fit.

Read the applicable delivery and after-sales conditions on the service where you will order. A Hacoo policy does not become the catalogue’s policy merely because both pages appear in the same research session. Save the order-specific terms and the selected variant. If a comparison depends on a discount, check whether that discount applies to your account and destination. Do not make a decision around a headline price whose conditions you have not seen.

sections.heading: Use a worked comparison without inventing product specifications
paragraphs: Imagine two candidate rows for a similar everyday trainer. Candidate A shows the colour you want and a clearly labelled foot-length chart, but has no buyer photo of the heel. Candidate B has several recent photos, yet its chart gives an unexplained length. These are example situations, not test results for products in our catalogue. The next action for A is to inspect the missing heel view; for B it is to clarify the measurement definition. Neither missing field can be solved by counting reviews.

Once the missing evidence arrives, compare both against your own reference and intended use. A narrow toe box may rule out a candidate even when its nominal length matches. A different fastening or padded lining may change the fit further. Record the reason for retaining or rejecting each option. That note is more valuable on your next visit than a star rating with no explanation, and it reduces the temptation to restart the same search from scratch.

sections.heading: Keep the shortlist useful when links change
paragraphs: Reopen every shortlisted destination before payment. If it no longer loads, use the original service's search, the saved listing ID and the exact style description. Our separate link troubleshooting guide explains how to distinguish an app-opening problem from an unavailable listing. Do not silently replace a dead row with a vaguely similar shoe: retain the old reference and make the replacement a new candidate. This preserves the connection between the photos you inspected and the item you actually select.

After delivery, compare the shoe and label with your saved option before discarding packaging. If something is wrong, document the whole item, the specific issue and the order identifier, then follow the actual order's support process. For your next shortlist, add what you learned about fit without presenting one personal experience as a universal size rule. A useful Hacoo shoe spreadsheet is a repeatable comparison method: exact link, exact variant, compatible measurements and evidence you can revisit.

takeaways: Keep Hacoo app links separate from the product catalogue.
Compare the selected style and the measurement method.
Photos show visible details; they do not guarantee authenticity or fit.
Recheck the destination and order terms before payment.

clothing-spreadsheet.title: Hacoo Clothing Spreadsheet: Hoodies, T-Shirts & Sets
clothing-spreadsheet.intro: Build a clothing shortlist with exact variants, garment measurements and material checks. Compare hoodies, T-shirts and matching sets without guessing sizes.

sections.heading: Organise clothing links around the outfit you need
paragraphs: A Hacoo clothing spreadsheet becomes useful when it answers a specific question: which of these hoodies, T-shirts or sets matches the fit and function I want? Begin with the category and intended use. A lightweight layer for indoors needs different evidence from a heavy outer layer. Record the exact destination and selected option next to the photograph. A collection of attractive pictures without current variant information is inspiration, not a reliable shopping comparison.

This independent guide links to the separate product catalogue for product discovery. Those catalogue links are not official Hacoo app links and do not confirm Hacoo stock. If your reference came from the Hacoo app, preserve that original link separately. Delivery terms, support and payment belong to the service where you actually place the order. This distinction matters when similar photographs appear on different websites: the image alone does not connect their inventories or policies.

sections.heading: Give each garment and variant its own row
paragraphs: Use columns for category, listing ID, colour or style, size, item count, material description, measurements, price currency and checked date. Put unknown information in an explicitly unconfirmed field. If one listing offers a T-shirt, hoodie and trousers, do not treat it as a single complete outfit. The cheapest option may be one piece. Select the desired variant and read what is included, then save the option name and the price shown after selection.

A matching set needs extra care. Confirm whether the top and bottom share one size or can be selected separately, whether accessories are included, and whether the displayed photograph shows the actual bundle. Record the measurements of both pieces even if the seller uses one size label for the set. Someone can need a different top and trouser size; an apparently convenient bundle can therefore be the least flexible choice. Do not infer bundle contents from styling props.

sections.heading: Use a well-fitting garment as your reference
paragraphs: Lay a similar garment flat without stretching it and measure it twice. For a T-shirt or hoodie, record chest width, body length, shoulder width and sleeve length using the same endpoints as the listing chart. Half-chest width is not chest circumference. For dropped shoulders, check where the sleeve measurement starts, because comparing it directly with a conventional shoulder seam can be misleading. Keep a quick drawing or photo of the tape position with your notes.

Compare shape as well as size. A boxy hoodie can be wider and shorter than a regular one; sizing up may lengthen sleeves without producing the silhouette you wanted. Choose a reference with similar fabric and purpose. A thin stretch T-shirt is a poor model for a rigid overshirt or a lined jacket. If the listing only supplies a size letter, that is insufficient evidence for a precise fit comparison. Ask for the missing dimensions instead of translating the letter into a universal measurement.

sections.heading: Check fabric claims and construction separately
paragraphs: Read the stated composition, lining, fastening and care instructions. A photograph cannot reliably establish fabric weight, fibre content or how a material feels against the skin. Terms such as premium and heavyweight need supporting details; a number without a unit or method is not enough. If weight is important, confirm whether the listing means fabric weight or the weight of the whole garment. These describe different things and should not be copied into the same comparison column.

For visual inspection, look at seams, collar shape, print placement, cuffs, hems and the alignment of pockets or zips. Compare full-garment views with close-ups. Check whether a photo belongs to the same colour and size, and whether it is a seller image or a buyer's delivered item. A review that explains washing, fit and the selected variant is often more useful than a short enthusiastic comment. Do not convert a favourable photo into a claim of authenticity or guaranteed durability.

sections.heading: Compare trousers and sets beyond the waistband
paragraphs: For trousers, record waist, rise, hip, thigh, inseam and leg opening when available. An elastic waistband should distinguish its relaxed and stretched measurement. A waist number alone says little about room through the seat or thighs. Inseam and total outer length begin at different points. If your reference trousers fit well, reproduce their measurement method and identify which dimension is least forgiving for you before selecting a size.

In a set, compare both pieces against separate references. The hoodie may look intentionally oversized while the trousers are comparatively narrow. Check colour matching in consistent lighting, while recognising that screens and lighting can change appearance. Confirm that the purchase includes both pieces in the colour shown. If one essential measurement or inclusion remains unclear, treat the entire bundle as unresolved rather than assuming the other half of the set will compensate for it.

sections.heading: Make a decision from a concrete comparison
paragraphs: Consider an example shortlist for a relaxed hoodie. One candidate gives chest and length measurements but omits sleeve length; another has all four measurements but uses a cropped shape. These are illustrative records, not product test results. Compare them with your existing hoodie. The first candidate requires the missing sleeve measurement; the second requires a decision about whether its shorter body matches your goal. Neither can be selected responsibly merely because both use the label oversized.

Then compare the actual selected-option price and the destination service's final charges. Hacoos.pro uses USD reference prices, while the payable amount and any shipping or tax appear on the destination. Save the selected variant, chart and inclusion list before checkout. An item that appears cheap can be unsuitable if you need to buy a second piece separately or if the fit information never becomes clear. The aim is a usable outfit, not the largest number of spreadsheet rows.

sections.heading: Keep a record that helps after delivery
paragraphs: Before removing labels or washing, compare the delivered garment with the saved listing, size label and expected contents. If there is a problem, photograph the complete item, the issue and the relevant measurement with the tape endpoints visible. Keep the packaging and order reference while you follow the actual order's after-sales process. Do not assume that a policy quoted for Hacoo also covers an order placed through another service.

Update your shortlist with what you learned: the variant received, how the garment compares with your reference and any material detail that was missing. Keep observations specific to that item and order. One successful purchase does not validate every colour, size or later batch under the same listing. Reopen the destination before a repeat purchase, because bundle contents, pictures and charts can change. For more detail, continue to our measurement guide or photo-checking guide in the same language.

takeaways: Give each garment and bundle option its own record.
Compare chest, length, shoulders and sleeves using matching methods.
Verify both pieces of a set and what the price includes.
Keep delivery and support terms tied to the actual ordering service.

links-not-working.title: Hacoo Links Not Working? App, Region & Listing Checks
links-not-working.intro: Troubleshoot Hacoo links that open the wrong page or show an unavailable item. Check the original link, app version, destination and exact variant in order.

sections.heading: Identify what failed before searching for a replacement
paragraphs: When Hacoo links stop working, the visible symptom matters. A link that opens a browser instead of the app is different from a product page that opens but says the item is unavailable. A page showing a different colour is a third problem. Write down exactly what happens and save the original URL, the message, your delivery country and the time. This small record prevents you from changing several variables at once and losing the evidence of the original failure.

There is no single fix that makes every removed listing return. A page can be unavailable because of a temporary loading issue, an app-opening problem, a regional restriction, a changed variant or a withdrawn offer. Those are possibilities to distinguish, not diagnoses we can infer from one screenshot. Start with the least disruptive checks. Avoid repeatedly paying for a replacement or changing your delivery details merely because a shared link no longer behaves as expected.

sections.heading: Confirm which service the link belongs to
paragraphs: Look at the full destination before following it. Preserve the original app share link rather than copying a shortened fragment from a caption. If a messaging app has broken the address across lines, obtain the complete link again. A link to a guide, social post or product catalogue may never have been an official Hacoo listing. Hacoos.pro is an independent reference site, and its product buttons lead to a separate catalogue. The two routes must not be treated as interchangeable.

For a problem with an existing order, begin inside the service where you placed that order. A guide site cannot inspect a Hacoo account or change its order status. If the source link points to an external catalogue, troubleshoot that destination and its search separately. Do not enter a password into an unfamiliar replacement page that claims it can recover a missing listing. Use the app's own account flow and the support details supplied with the order.

sections.heading: Check app opening and version without losing your record
paragraphs: Update Hacoo from the official app store available to you, then close and reopen the app and try the original link again. If it opens inside a social app's built-in browser, try its normal open-in-browser or open-in-app option when available. Interface labels differ between devices and app versions, so do not assume a missing button means the product has disappeared. First establish whether the app itself loads normally and whether another known link opens.

If other pages work but this one does not, the evidence points toward that particular link or listing rather than a complete connection failure. If nothing loads, check your connection and retry once through a normal network you trust. Keep your saved URLs and screenshots before signing out or clearing local app data. Reinstalling is not a necessary first step, and it cannot restore a listing that the service has withdrawn. Avoid cycling through disruptive changes without a reason.

sections.heading: Verify the real destination country and account context
paragraphs: Check the actual delivery country and any region setting visible in the app. Availability may depend on the market or destination, but a report from another user does not prove that region is the cause in your case. Note the setting and whether the listing changes after you correct an accidental mismatch. Do not use a false shipping address or someone else's account to force a different view. Seeing an item does not establish that it can be delivered to you.

If the person sharing the link is in another country, ask for the listing identifier, exact style and date of their screenshot. Those details help you compare like with like without copying their account settings. Promotions and options may also differ. Keep the question narrow: can the same listing and variant be opened for your real destination? If the platform says no, an unrelated accessible product is an alternative to evaluate, not evidence that the original link has been repaired.

sections.heading: Separate a missing variant from a missing listing
paragraphs: A destination can still exist while the selected size, colour or bundle has disappeared. Open the available option selector and compare its current choices with the screenshot you saved. Check the listing ID, first image and style name before assuming that a different default option is the same product. If the page has changed identity, treat the old row as stale even if the URL returns a successful page. Technical reachability and a correct product match are separate checks.

An item not existing message does not, by itself, identify whether the offer was withdrawn, moved or unavailable in your context. Use the service's search with the saved ID where supported, then a precise description of the item. A broad brand search can produce similar-looking but unrelated results. When you find a candidate, verify it from the beginning: destination, variant, measurements, price and terms. Do not transfer old reviews or photos to a new listing without establishing their connection.

sections.heading: Send support the evidence needed to reproduce the issue
paragraphs: If the problem concerns an order or remains unresolved, contact the relevant service through its official support route. Supply the original link, listing or order identifier, exact error message, app version, device type and real destination country. Explain what you already tried and when it last worked. A concise chronology is more useful than several screenshots with no dates. Keep account identifiers private and never include passwords, login codes or full payment details in a public comment.

For example, describe that the original link opens the app but shows an unavailable-item message, while other listings load, and include the saved style name. This is an example of a useful report, not evidence of a current Hacoo outage. Ask whether the specific listing and variant remain available for your destination. Support may be able to clarify availability; it cannot be assumed that an independent catalogue can restore stock or recover an order on another platform.

sections.heading: Repair your saved list and choose the next step
paragraphs: Mark the original row unavailable or unconfirmed with the date and observed message. Keep its old identifier instead of overwriting it. If you choose an alternative, add a new row and compare it as a new purchase. This is particularly important for multi-style footwear and clothing sets, where similar pictures can hide different sizes or inclusions. A spreadsheet becomes more trustworthy when it exposes uncertainty instead of presenting every link as currently verified.

Once the route works, return to the product checks: selected option, matching photos, usable measurement chart and final terms. For a Hacoo order already in transit, use the tracking guide rather than repeating product searches. For a new catalogue search, use the catalogue search on this site. The goal is to know which service and item you are dealing with, what failed and what evidence resolves it. A working link is the beginning of that process, not the end.

takeaways: Record the exact failure and keep the original URL.
Distinguish app-opening, destination and variant problems.
Check the real country and official app version.
Treat replacement listings as new candidates.

tracking-not-updating.title: Hacoo Tracking Not Updating: Stages & Next Steps
tracking-not-updating.intro: Understand label creation, carrier handover and delivery exceptions. Check Hacoo tracking against the actual order estimate and know what to send support.

sections.heading: Read the latest event before counting days
paragraphs: Hacoo tracking not updating does not describe one single situation. An order awaiting processing, a label created before carrier collection and a parcel between scans can all look quiet. Start with the most recent event, its timestamp, the tracking number and the delivery estimate attached to your actual order. Save those details together. An order number identifies the purchase, while a tracking number identifies a shipment; they are not necessarily interchangeable.

This guide explains how to interpret information you can see. Hacoos.pro cannot access your account, locate a parcel or promise a delivery date. If you ordered through another service, use that service's order information. The product catalogue linked elsewhere on this site is separate from Hacoo. Its product links do not provide access to Hacoo orders, and Hacoo's published shipping estimates should not be applied to a purchase made on a different platform.

sections.heading: Use the official estimate with the right boundaries
paragraphs: The Hacoo Shipping & Delivery page checked on 9 October 2026 gives a general receiving estimate of 15–28 days and says processing normally takes 3–5 business days. It also lists destination-specific receiving ranges: 15–25 days for the UK, France, Germany and Italy; 15–30 for Spain; and 25–65 for other countries. These are published guidelines, not promises for an individual order. The page expressly says specific delivery dates are not guaranteed.

The same page defines receiving time as processing plus shipping. Do not add processing again to a receiving estimate that already includes it, and do not turn a fastest express-shipping example into a normal delivery expectation. Business days and calendar days also describe different clocks. Check the wording in your order, the selected service and destination before comparing dates. If the order supplies a different applicable estimate, save that record and ask support to explain any conflict with the general page.

sections.heading: Distinguish label creation from carrier possession
paragraphs: A label-created or shipment-information-received event commonly means that electronic shipment details exist. It does not always prove the carrier has physically collected the parcel. Look for a collection, acceptance or origin-facility scan before assuming the shipment has begun moving. The exact terms vary by carrier, so use the carrier's own event explanation where available. Keep the original event text rather than replacing it with a guess such as lost or stuck in customs.

If your order remains in processing, check for a preorder, backorder or item-specific dispatch note. Hacoo's public shipping page says available items can ship separately from preordered or backordered items. One order can therefore have more than one parcel. Compare the contents assigned to each shipment and its tracking number. A delivered parcel containing only part of the order does not automatically mean the remaining items were forgotten, but you should confirm their status in the actual order.

sections.heading: Compare the app and carrier records
paragraphs: Open the tracking link supplied in the order and confirm that its number matches the number shown in the app. Read the carrier's latest timestamp and location alongside the app's summary. Updates may appear at different times, and a handover can introduce a local delivery partner or another tracking reference. Record both references if the order provides them. Do not substitute an unrelated number found in a social post or assume every tracking website uses identical status definitions.

A gap between scans can occur during transport, handover or other processing, but the gap alone does not prove which event is happening. Check for a specific exception, request for information or attempted delivery. If a message asks for a payment or address correction, verify it through the order's official route before acting. Unexpected messages can imitate carrier notifications. The useful question is what the carrier actually reports, not which explanation seems most reassuring in a forum thread.

sections.heading: Act on exceptions instead of waiting for a universal deadline
paragraphs: There is no evidence-based number of silent days that guarantees every Hacoo parcel is lost. Use the order's promised or estimated window, the last scan and any specific exception together. If the stated window has passed, the tracking reports an address problem, or the carrier asks for action, contact the relevant support channel promptly. An incorrect address should be raised immediately; the official shipping page says the opportunity to correct it can be small because processing moves quickly.

If tracking says delivered but you have not received the parcel, check the delivery information, building reception and any authorised safe place, then contact the carrier and the ordering service. Preserve the delivery timestamp and any photo or signature information supplied. Do not wait for another ordinary transit scan to resolve a delivered event. Ask for the delivery investigation process and keep the case reference. This is a different situation from a parcel that has not yet received an acceptance scan.

sections.heading: Prepare a concise support record
paragraphs: Send the order identifier, shipment number, destination, order date, last event and the delivery estimate shown when you ordered. Attach clear screenshots of the order and carrier record, with dates visible. State whether all items or only part of the order are affected. Explain any address correction or support contact already made. A chronological record helps the recipient distinguish a dispatch delay from a carrier issue without repeatedly asking for the same details.

For example, a useful message says that one of two parcels was delivered, identifies the missing parcel and quotes its last scan and timestamp. This is a reporting example, not a claim about your order. Keep passwords, one-time codes and full payment information out of the message. If the support route requests additional evidence, supply it within that service's instructions and retain the response. A public comment under a product guide is not a substitute for an order-specific case.

sections.heading: Preserve after-sales options and close the record carefully
paragraphs: The shipping page reviewed for this guide says after-sales support can be requested within 15 days of delivery and that refund instructions must be followed. It also describes a no-return approach on that page. Do not interpret that wording as an unconditional refund or assume it overrides the conditions attached to your particular order. Check the actual support flow and raise the issue promptly. Do not mark an undelivered parcel received simply to try to unlock another screen.

Once the parcel arrives, compare its contents with the order before discarding labels and packaging. Photograph damage, missing items or a wrong variant and keep the relevant tracking history until the case is resolved. If delivery is still unresolved, update your record with the support case and next action instead of repeatedly checking several third-party trackers. The best next step follows the evidence: clarify processing, verify carrier handover, respond to an exception or request an investigation when the applicable delivery window has passed.

takeaways: Receiving estimates already include processing where the policy says so.
Label creation is not the same as confirmed carrier collection.
Compare each parcel with its own tracking number and contents.
Escalate exceptions and overdue orders with a dated evidence record.

canary-islands-shipping.title: Does Hacoo ship to the Canary Islands? Check your postcode
canary-islands-shipping.intro: If you want to order from Hacoo in Tenerife, Gran Canaria or another Canary Island, start with the delivery address for that order. Hacoo’s public shipping page lists Spain and gives a national delivery estimate. It does not give an island-by-island coverage list or a rate for a particular Canary Islands postcode. The useful check is whether Hacoo offers a delivery method and a price for the item and address you actually intend to use. You can review those details before deciding whether to pay.

sections.heading: Enter the address that will receive the parcel
paragraphs: In the Hacoo account you plan to order from, open the address section and add or review your delivery address. Hacoo’s EU help centre describes an address menu under the account menu. If the labels look different in your version of the app, look for the saved addresses used for delivery. Enter Spain, the actual postcode, municipality and street address. Where there are separate fields, use the province and town from your normal postal address. An island name on its own can leave the town or street ambiguous.

When you return to the basket, check which saved address is selected. A mainland address used for a previous purchase may still appear as the default. Changing the language to Spanish or displaying prices in euros tells you little about where this particular parcel will go. Read the summary line showing the destination, right down to the postcode. If the address selector suggests a different municipality, stop and check the address you entered before comparing delivery options.

sections.heading: Check one exact item before you build a basket
paragraphs: Begin with one item you would genuinely buy. Select the colour, size and quantity, open the basket in the official ordering service and continue to the delivery summary. Look for the selected address, a usable delivery option and the amount shown for shipping. If an arrival estimate appears, note the wording and date as well. A saved or shared product page can be a convenient way to find the item again, but the price visible in a catalogue cannot answer the delivery question for your basket.

Suppose you are comparing two similar pairs of shoes for delivery to Tenerife. Check the first pair in your size against your saved address. Then use the same address, quantity and size selection to check the second pair. If one shows a method and the other does not, you have learned something about those two offers. You still have no basis for saying that every shoe ships to Tenerife or that the entire island is excluded. Keeping the address fixed also makes any difference easier to explain to support.

sections.heading: Read the delivery result before deciding what to do
paragraphs: If the correct address remains selected and a delivery method and fee appear, save the quote if you want to compare later. Check the summary again just before payment, particularly after changing the quantity, applying an offer or entering a second address. If a shipping line explicitly shows zero, record it as the price quoted for that basket. An empty shipping field or a placeholder is a different result: the page has not given you a final shipping price.

If the address is accepted but the basket has no delivery method, try the original item on its own. If that works, add the other items back one at a time. If the single-item basket also fails, keep the exact message and item reference. Where the address itself is rejected, first correct any typo or mismatch between town, province and postcode. Do not replace your address with a mainland postcode to get past the form. A price calculated for that postcode tells you nothing about delivery to your door.

sections.heading: Find the actual shipping cost for your address
paragraphs: Hacoo’s shipping-fee information directs shoppers to checkout for the exact basic fee and describes weight as a factor. For a Canary Islands delivery, use the shipping line tied to your address and selected items. Separate the item subtotal, shipping, any displayed discount and the final amount payable. If a promotion applies, note where the deduction appears. A lower final total could come from a discount on the product while the shipping charge stays the same.

For a practical comparison, keep one note for a basket with just the shoes and another for the shoes plus a hoodie. Record the date, item quantities, delivery method, shipping amount and final total for each. This shows what the extra item would cost you in practice without assuming that each item attracts an identical charge. If shipping only appears late in checkout, wait for that line before comparing totals. A quote from a friend in Madrid or an older screenshot from another buyer is missing your exact destination, contents and date.

sections.heading: Understand the 15–30 day estimate for Spain
paragraphs: Hacoo’s public shipping page gives Spain a receiving-time estimate of 15–30 days. The same page describes receiving time as including processing and transport and says that estimates can vary. Treat that range as a starting point for planning. There is no separate Canary Islands deadline on the page. If your checkout or order confirmation shows a delivery window, copy it with the order date. Avoid adding the general processing period a second time to a window already described as the total time to receive the order.

A preorder can change how you interpret the dates. Hacoo says available items may ship separately from items that are preordered or awaiting stock. If you order two garments and see a tracking number for one, open the order details and check which garment belongs to that parcel. Keep the estimate and tracking reference for each shipment. If you need the second garment for a particular day, base your decision on the information for that garment. The delivery of the first parcel cannot tell you when the second one will arrive.

sections.heading: Ask Hacoo a question it can answer
paragraphs: If the basket still shows no usable option, use Hacoo’s in-app support channel. A useful first message is: “I’m trying to order [item reference and variant] for [postcode and municipality], Canary Islands, Spain. The saved address is accepted, but checkout shows [exact message]. Is delivery available for this item at that postcode, and where can I see the full shipping charge?” A cropped screenshot can show the delivery message without publishing your full address or payment details. Mention whether the item was alone in the basket.

If you have already paid and notice the wrong address, contact Hacoo promptly with your order reference through the order or account support route. The public shipping page says the window for correcting an address is small. Check the address recorded against the actual order even if you have since updated your address book. Keep any response with the order, particularly if the parcel has already been handed to a carrier. The outcome of a correction depends on the order’s stage.

faqs.q: Does Hacoo deliver to all the Canary Islands?
faqs.a: The official Spain information does not list coverage by island or postcode. Use the full delivery address and selected item at checkout. If no method appears, ask support about that exact combination.

faqs.q: Is shipping to the Canary Islands free?
faqs.a: Use the shipping charge shown for your basket. A zero amount explicitly shown at checkout is evidence for that order. A blank field, another buyer’s promotion or a mainland delivery price cannot establish your fee.

faqs.q: Does a working product link mean I can order it to Gran Canaria?
faqs.a: Opening the listing confirms that you can view it. Check your exact variant and delivery address in the basket to see whether the ordering service offers shipping.

faqs.q: Can I compare two addresses without paying?
faqs.a: If both are genuine delivery options, select each in turn and review the final delivery summary before authorising payment. Note the postcode associated with each quote and restore the intended address before placing an order.

wrong-size-returns.title: Hacoo returns and refunds when the size is wrong
wrong-size-returns.intro: Start with the size saved on the paid order. Lay the item beside its original bag and check the sewn-in label. Those two pieces of information usually tell you which problem to report. An M on the order and an S on the garment is a different case from an M that pulls across the shoulders. Keep the packaging and tags while you work out which applies. Open the request through the service that actually took your order.

sections.heading: Which size problem do you have?
paragraphs: If the garment label differs from the ordered option, photograph both. Make sure colour, style and quantity identify the same order line, especially if you bought several similar basics. A bag sticker that says M and a garment tag that says S are both worth showing. Describe the disagreement and let support identify whether the bag, the item or its label was mixed up. A changing product page is a poor substitute for your original order confirmation.

If the labels match but the item is uncomfortable, identify where the fit breaks down. A jacket can fit across the chest and still bind when you reach forward. A shoe can have enough length and too little room over the toes. There is also a third possibility: the correct label arrived but the finished item appears to differ from an explicit measurement in the listing. Save that particular chart and check how the seller took the measurement before choosing the reason for your request.

sections.heading: Assemble the evidence for this item
paragraphs: Save the order line showing the selected size, the product name and the amount paid. Take a full photo of the item, a close photo of its size label and a clear photo of the barcode on the original product bag. Hacoo’s return help specifically asks for the label, barcode and the part that feels too large or too small. Keep the images together so a sleeve measurement from one sweatshirt cannot be mistaken for another. Add the date you received this item.

For a two-piece set, record which half is affected and whether each piece has its own label. If you bought an L and an XL to compare, keep the two bags apart. Take one picture of each garment beside its own bag before repacking. Check whether the order lists a single set or two separate items. That determines what you need to ask about if the trousers fit and the matching top is the wrong size.

sections.heading: Take measurements the reviewer can reproduce
paragraphs: Lay a hoodie flat on a level surface, smooth the fabric and leave it unstretched. If the listing measures chest width from one underarm to the other, use those same points. Show the zero mark and final reading in the same photograph, with the unit visible. A second, wider image can establish where you put the tape. Flat garment width, circumference and the buyer’s body measurement are three different quantities. Identify which one the chart uses before drawing a conclusion.

Consider an illustrative listing that gives a flat chest width of 54 cm for M. You measure 49 cm between the same points. Report the two readings, attach the chart for that option and mention any published tolerance. This example establishes no universal threshold. For shoes, photograph the size label inside each shoe and the box label. Include the sizing system printed beside the number. Compare a foot-length field with your foot and an insole-length field with an insole only if the listing specifies that method.

sections.heading: Send one clear request and keep the deadline
paragraphs: Open the affected order in the account used for payment. Choose the relevant item and quantity, then look for the after-sales or return option. Hacoo’s help also describes starting a return request through account support. The public policy gives a 15-day window after receipt for its ordinary return route and lists conditions for the item. Read the instructions for your product and destination straight away. Keep a copy of the initial request and the timestamp, especially if support later asks for more photos.

A useful message is short: “My order shows a black hoodie in M. The sewn-in label says S and the outer bag says M. I have attached all three photos. Please confirm the return method and who covers postage.” If the labels match, replace that middle sentence with your actual fit or measurement issue. If you would prefer a different size, ask what this particular order offers. Wait for the answer before placing and paying for a second order that depends on the first being refunded.

sections.heading: Agree the postage and contents before sending anything
paragraphs: Hacoo’s returns policy assigns return postage to the buyer for an ordinary change-of-mind return and says it covers applicable costs for an accepted incorrect-item case. Its shipping information also describes an after-sales route that can proceed without posting an item. The return decision for your order should tell you which route applies. Ask for the destination, any label, the dispatch deadline and whether you must advance postage. If reimbursement is offered, ask which service and proof of payment it accepts.

Before accepting a proposed refund, check the amount against the price paid for the affected item after discounts. Separate that price from original delivery charges and new return postage. If you paid for a bundle, ask whether the offer assumes you will send back the whole bundle. Use the address or label supplied for the approved case. Keep the carrier receipt showing dispatch and the tracking reference. If support tells you to keep the item, save that instruction alongside the refund decision.

sections.heading: Track the refund from the right starting point
paragraphs: Note four dates separately: the request, the decision, any return delivery and the date the service says it issued the refund. A message acknowledging your photos says little about when a credit will reach your account. Check the amount, currency and destination named in the decision. Only start counting a payment provider’s processing window once you know the refund was actually sent to that provider.

Hacoo’s public refund policy quotes 5–7 working days for PayPal and 8–15 working days for a credit card. The EU help page says the original payment channel affects the time. Treat any estimate against the payment route and terms shown on your own case. If that window has passed, reopen the same conversation with the order line, refund reference, amount and issue date. If support says your case is awaiting a return scan instead, send the acceptance receipt and tracking record for that parcel.

faqs.q: Can I return a garment after washing it to see if it shrinks?
faqs.a: Check eligibility before washing or altering it. Hacoo’s ordinary return conditions call for original packaging, tags and an unused, unwashed item. A photo of an existing label or size discrepancy is easier to assess while the condition is still as delivered.

faqs.q: What if the order only shows a number such as 40?
faqs.a: Look for the size system on the selected option and the label. If the listing never specified one, show the two records to support and ask how they correspond. Keep your original order screenshot when the live listing has since changed.

faqs.q: What if I threw away the bag with the barcode?
faqs.a: Tell support what is missing and supply the order line, full item and sewn-in label. Ask what other identification they accept for that item. A barcode from another purchase would point the reviewer to the wrong product.

faqs.q: Can I request an exchange for the next size up?
faqs.a: Check the remedies displayed in your order. One Hacoo help page describes returns without direct exchanges. Ask whether a replacement is available and what you would pay for it before assuming you can swap at the original promotional price.

delivered-not-received.title: Hacoo Says Delivered but My Parcel Is Missing: What to Check
delivered-not-received.intro: When Hacoo tracking says “delivered” and you have nothing in your hands, open the shipment inside your order. Match the tracking number, check the stated drop-off point and ask anyone who could have accepted it. If the parcel is still missing, contact the delivery carrier and open a report through the service where you ordered. The steps below help you give each team the details it can actually use.

sections.heading: Find the tracking number for the missing parcel
paragraphs: Start with the order confirmation. Open the account or storefront that issued it and look at the shipments attached to that order. Note which products belong to each parcel. Hacoo explains on its website that it can send available items first when an order also contains preordered or back-ordered items. Two items paid for together can therefore arrive under different numbers.

Consider an order for trainers and a hoodie. If the trainers arrived and the hoodie has its own number showing it is still in transit, follow that second shipment. If the order assigns both items to the parcel you opened, keep the packaging, label and a photo of what arrived. Report a missing item from a received parcel. If you received neither item and the matching tracking number shows delivery, continue with a missing-parcel report. These three situations call for different evidence.

sections.heading: Read the last event on the carrier’s own page
paragraphs: Follow the tracking link in your order to the company that handled the final delivery. Look for a local tracking number if a cross-border carrier handed it over. Record the delivery date, local time if stated, delivery description and any named pickup location. Save the history as well as the final event, so a support agent can identify the handover if the number changes between carriers.

Check the exact verb. A parcel that has arrived at a local depot is still with the carrier. A parcel ready for collection may be waiting behind a counter or inside a locker. If the carrier says it was collected, but you never collected it, report that specific discrepancy and ask it to verify the collection record. If the app shows delivery while the carrier still shows transit, send both dated screens and ask which event refers to your parcel.

sections.heading: Check the address and handover point
paragraphs: Compare the shipping address saved on the order with the place you expected delivery. Pay particular attention to flat numbers, building entrances and any safe-place instruction you gave. Look in the mailbox for a collection slip. Check the stated spot, accessible common parcel area and reception desk. Ask household members, a concierge or the neighbour identified on the notification whether they accepted it. These are the first checks Hacoo’s EU help page recommends.

For an apartment delivery, a photo of a door may give you something more precise to check: the flat number, a row of buzzers or the colour of the entrance. If it appears to show a different building, tell the carrier which detail differs. If you cannot recognise the location, say exactly that. You can ask the carrier to investigate without identifying another tenant, sharing someone else’s photo publicly or entering private premises.

sections.heading: Ask the final carrier for proof of delivery
paragraphs: Contact the carrier through the tracking page or its own customer service. Give the local tracking number, the date of the delivered event and your delivery postcode. Ask whether the parcel was handed to a person, left at an agreed location or marked delivered to a collection point. Request whatever delivery confirmation the carrier can share, such as a drop-off description, photo or signature record. The available information varies by carrier and service.

If a photo shows your building but the parcel has gone, distinguish what you recognise from what you received. If the carrier can investigate only at the sender’s request, ask for a case number or written confirmation of that instruction. Pass it to the ordering service so it can raise the request with its shipping partner. Write down the contact date and the next update the carrier offered; it gives you a concrete point for a follow-up.

sections.heading: Open the case through the service where you ordered
paragraphs: On the EU Hacoo help page for this problem, the route starts in the affected order: select Refund/Exchange, then the reason for a refund because the package was not received. Follow the options shown in your version of the app to request an investigation. In contrast, Hacoo’s web shipping page directs shoppers with a delivered-but-missing parcel to the carrier named on the tracking page and then to customer support for help. Use the instructions attached to your own receipt and order.

If you discovered the product here but checked out through another catalogue or ordering service, take the case to the account holding the transaction. A product-link directory cannot access the delivery record or approve a refund. If Hacoo is the ordering service and the missing-package option is absent, use its in-app support for that order. Quote the words on your screen and ask where to submit the missing-delivery evidence. Keep an image of the available options.

sections.heading: Send a report someone can act on
paragraphs: Put the order number, missing parcel number and last-mile carrier at the top. Describe the last event, which drop-off locations you checked, whether someone accepted the parcel and what the carrier told you. Include the case reference if you have it. Attach the relevant tracking history, available delivery proof and a list of the missing items when an order has several shipments. Use the private support channel and crop unrelated orders or payment details from screenshots.

A short message you can adapt: “Order [number], parcel [tracking number]. The carrier recorded delivery on [date/time] at [location shown]. I checked [places] and asked [household/reception]. The parcel is missing. The carrier’s reference is [number]; it said [reply]. Please investigate this shipment and tell me when to expect an update.” Where an item from another parcel has arrived, add its tracking number on a separate line so nobody closes the missing case against the successful delivery.

sections.heading: Keep the case open through the next decision
paragraphs: Hacoo’s app shipping policy gives a window of 15 days from the delivered tracking event for refund enquiries about a missing parcel. Its web shipping page separately describes after-sales support within 15 days of delivery. Check the conditions shown for your order and start promptly; waiting for a carrier’s final investigation could use up the period displayed. Save the date you submitted the request, your support reference and the attachments you sent.

If a reply repeats the tracking status, reply in the same case and point to the unresolved question: where was it left, who accepted it, or which local number proves the handover? Ask the service to explain the next step and any additional evidence it needs. A submitted report starts a review. The decision about a replacement or refund comes from the ordering service. If the parcel turns up, tell both teams and keep their acknowledgement with the order.

faqs.q: Should I wait a few days after the delivered scan?
faqs.a: Check the location and ask people at the address as soon as you see the scan. If those checks do not locate it, report it promptly. If the carrier asks you to wait for an update, note the date and check the separate deadline in your order.

faqs.q: What if the carrier cannot share a delivery photo?
faqs.a: Ask for the available handover details and an enquiry reference. Some services record a location or delivery method without a photo. Tell the ordering service what information the carrier could provide and ask whether the sender can obtain more.

faqs.q: What if I accidentally marked the order received?
faqs.a: Contact the ordering service promptly through the original order. Give the actual timeline, explain which confirmation you selected and include the carrier’s status. Let support tell you which route is still available for that transaction.
